purpose: Consolidated preflight boundary for a known-profile commercial nonfiction book before full production build.
required_inputs: approved or explicitly proof-only cover direction
approved or explicitly proof-only interior design profile
format targets for print and digital

checks.requirement: Manuscript must be approved for production; unresolved P0/P1 factual blockers stop the build.
All source markers used in reader-facing notes must resolve to normalized source records.

Print and digital artifacts must use real title, author and clean copyright text. Print TOC uses generated final page numbers; Kindle source uses semantic headings without print pagination. No proof labels may leak into reader-facing pages.
A new commercial cover direction requires human visual approval before final production.
A new interior profile requires human visual approval before profile admission.
Interior visuals are opt-in. A visual is included only when approved and when data/source provenance or clear explanatory payoff is recorded; zero visuals is valid.
Paperback, Kindle/EPUB, covers, links, and notes are validated as separate artifacts, not as one generic manuscript export.
Every chapter starts on a new page; suspicious pre-chapter occupancy, blank pages, isolated headings and heading hyphenation block release-candidate status.
Reader-facing notes use identifiable public sources and professional links; internal aliases, filesystem paths and provenance language remain internal.
Every final paperback page must appear in a contact sheet before profile admission.

prohibited_shortcuts: single primitive cover proof as commercial art direction
technical PDF PASS treated as visual approval
fake or partial TOC used for production acceptance
print pagination or running heads carried into Kindle source
duplicated title/copyright pages in Kindle output
generic arrow or box diagrams admitted as production visuals without explanatory value
